svg.title: ThingsBoard 3.6 限流与 API Usage 完整时序

g.text: ThingsBoard 3.6 限流与 API Usage 完整时序
通用 REST 瞬时限流：本机 Bucket4j
One LocalBucket can contain multiple Bandwidths.
Bucket state is not shared across JVMs.
The tenant token is not refunded.
Transport：API state 开关 + tenant/device 本机桶
buckets are not one transaction; earlier tokens are not refunded.
A device regular-bucket failure does not refund the tenant token.
API Usage 生产、周期汇总与队列
This is best-effort metering, not a billing ledger.
Process exit, read/clear races or send failure can undercount.
Failed/timed-out items are logged, then the pack is committed.
Crash after processing but before commit can replay and overcount.
Owner：月/小时计数、阈值与分离持久化
find state row by owner entity id
create ENABLED row with new ApiUsageStateId
Old ApiUsageStateId timeseries is not re-associated.
getOrFetchState does not recalculate every feature here.
last value by serviceId; periodic sum
状态变化：row、广播、时序、通知
WARNING -> ENABLED does not trigger initialization;
State row, count/state timeseries, queue commits and notifications
do not share one transaction or a cluster-wide barrier.
DISABLED 在各执行点的不同硬行为
UTC 小时/月重置与恢复
Hourly values reset lazily when a new usage message arrives.
Restart/repartition rebuilds current UTC cycle from latest timestamps.
